prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1452; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with a recent collision in which the client's vehicle was sideswiped while the client was changing lanes. The client has sustained injuries and is undergoing treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact the client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you provide a complete statement of the policy limits applicable to the at-fault driver's liability coverage, along with any declarations page or other documentation confirming those limits. We also ask that you confirm in writing whether any excess or umbrella coverage may apply.

Please ensure that all evidence relating to this incident is preserved. This includes the claim file, recorded statements, photographs, repair estimates, vehicle data, telematics information, and any dash camera or surveillance footage in your possession or control. Kindly confirm that a litigation hold has been placed on these materials. We look forward to your prompt written response.
